costNote: Making aligners and scanners. It FELL $39M year over year (productivity and 3D-printing efficiency) even as volume rose — the main reason profit jumped.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: The doctor-facing sales machine and corporate costs — trimmed $7M year over year on expense discipline.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: The pipeline: NXT direct-fabrication 3D-printing materials, the Specifix attachment system, and a 3D-printed sports guard now in US pilot.

opex.name: Restructuring & other charges
opex.note: Down from $32M a year ago as the restructuring program winds down.

opex.name: Legal settlements & contingencies
opex.note: A charge that didn't exist a year ago; $76M year to date, so this line bears watching.

segments.name: Clear Aligners
segments.note: Invisalign — 690,600 cases shipped, up 6.6%, a record Q3, with record doctor submitters. Revenue grew more slowly (+4.2%) than cases because average selling prices fell on mix.

segments.name: Imaging & CAD/CAM Services
segments.note: iTero scanners and exocad software — revenue down 7.6% on comparisons, though cumulative placements passed 157,000 systems and unit placements grew double-digits.

sources.label: Align Technology Q3 2026 earnings release — SEC EDGAR Ex-99.1 (8-K, Oct 28, 2026)

takeaways.text: Operating margin jumped from 9.7% to 16.7% — almost all of it cost: manufacturing cost fell $39M and restructuring charges halved. GAAP EPS more than doubled to $1.90.
takeaways.title: Profit grew from the cost line

takeaways.text: Aligner case volume rose 6.6% — record Q3 shipments, record doctor submitters, and North America orthodontist shipments grew year over year for the first time in six quarters.
takeaways.title: Volumes are back

takeaways.text: Scanner and software revenue fell 7.6% even as placements grew double digits — more systems are leased/rented/pre-owned, which spreads the revenue out instead of booking it upfront.
takeaways.title: Scanners: units up, revenue down

verdict: Slow growth, fast profit: revenue up just 1.9%, but cheaper manufacturing and discipline more than doubled GAAP EPS.
